It has further submitted that the said Articles are restitutive provisions and thus ought to be given a wide interpretation. Referring to the judgment of the Tribunal in Wardha‟s case, the Petitioner has submitted that the said judgment has recognized the principle that in order to restore the affected party to the same economic position, compensation for change in law claims has to be such, as to reimburse the affected party for the expense actually incurred.
